```{r}
# libraries

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
data(iris)
data(mtcars)
data(airquality)
data(ToothGrowth)


# Q1. Data Exploration
cat("\n--- Q1: Data Exploration ---\n")
print(head(iris, 10))
print(tail(iris, 5))
cat("Rows:", nrow(iris), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(iris), "\n")
print(names(iris))
str(iris)

# Q2. Variables and Data Types
cat("\n--- Q2: Data Types ---\n")
print(sapply(mtcars, class))
mtcars$cyl <- as.factor(mtcars$cyl)
mtcars$gear <- as.factor(mtcars$gear)
print(table(mtcars$cyl))
print(table(mtcars$gear))

# Q3. Descriptive Statistics
cat("\n--- Q3: Descriptive Statistics ---\n")
for (variable in c("Sepal.Length", "Petal.Length")) {
  x <- iris[[variable]]
  cat("\nVariable:", variable, "\n")
  cat("Mean:", mean(x), "\n")
  cat("Median:", median(x), "\n")
  cat("Minimum:", min(x), "\n")
  cat("Maximum:", max(x), "\n")
  cat("Standard Deviation:", sd(x), "\n")
}

# Q4. Missing Values
cat("\n--- Q4: Missing Values ---\n")
print(colSums(is.na(airquality)))
cat("Ozone missing percentage:",
    mean(is.na(airquality$Ozone)) * 100, "%\n")
cat("Solar.R missing percentage:",
    mean(is.na(airquality$Solar.R)) * 100, "%\n")

# Q5. Indexing and Subsetting
cat("\n--- Q5: Indexing and Subsetting ---\n")
print(iris[1:15, ])
print(iris[, c("Sepal.Length", "Sepal.Width", "Species")])
print(subset(iris, Petal.Length > 5))

# Q6. Filter Rows
cat("\n--- Q6: Filter Rows ---\n")
print(
  mtcars %>%
    filter(mpg > 20, hp < 100) %>%
    select(mpg, hp, wt, cyl)
)

# Q7. Select and Arrange
cat("\n--- Q7: Select and Arrange ---\n")
print(
  iris %>%
    select(Species, Sepal.Length, Petal.Length) %>%
    arrange(desc(Petal.Length))
)

# Q8. Create New Variables
cat("\n--- Q8: Power-to-Weight Ratio ---\n")
print(
  mtcars %>%
    mutate(power_to_weight = hp / wt) %>%
    arrange(desc(power_to_weight)) %>%
    head(5)
)

# Q9. Group By and Summarise
cat("\n--- Q9: Species Statistics ---\n")
print(
  iris %>%
    group_by(Species) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_sepal = mean(Sepal.Length),
      sd_sepal = sd(Sepal.Length),
      mean_petal = mean(Petal.Length),
      sd_petal = sd(Petal.Length),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
)

# Q10. Multiple Operations
cat("\n--- Q10: Cylinder Group Analysis ---\n")
print(
  mtcars %>%
    group_by(cyl) %>%
    summarise(
      number_of_cars = n(),
      average_mpg = mean(mpg),
      average_hp = mean(hp),
      maximum_weight = max(wt),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(average_mpg))
)


# Q11. Summary Analysis
cat("\n--- Q11: Summary Analysis ---\n")
print(summary(iris))
sd_values <- sapply(iris[, 1:4], sd)
print(sd_values)
cat("Highest standard deviation variable:",
    names(sd_values)[which.max(sd_values)], "\n")

# Q12. Correlation Analysis
cat("\n--- Q12: Correlation Analysis ---\n")
data_corr <- mtcars[, c("mpg", "hp", "wt", "disp")]
cor_matrix <- cor(data_corr)
print(cor_matrix)

# Find the pair with the strongest absolute correlation
upper_corr <- cor_matrix
upper_corr[lower.tri(upper_corr, diag = TRUE)] <- NA
max_position <- which(
  abs(upper_corr) == max(abs(upper_corr), na.rm = TRUE),
  arr.ind = TRUE
)
cat("Strongest pair:",
    rownames(upper_corr)[max_position[1, 1]], "and",
    colnames(upper_corr)[max_position[1, 2]], "\n")
cat("Correlation:",
    upper_corr[max_position[1, 1], max_position[1, 2]], "\n")

# Q13. Data Visualization
cat("\n--- Q13: Data Visualization ---\n")

# Histogram
hist(
  iris$Sepal.Length,
  main = "Histogram of Sepal Length",
  xlab = "Sepal Length",
  col = "lightblue",
  border = "black"
)

# Boxplot
boxplot(
  Petal.Length ~ Species,
  data = iris,
  main = "Petal Length by Species",
  xlab = "Species",
  ylab = "Petal Length",
  col = c("lightblue", "lightgreen", "lightpink")
)

# Scatter plot
plot(
  iris$Sepal.Length,
  iris$Petal.Length,
  col = as.numeric(iris$Species),
  pch = 19,
  main = "Sepal Length vs Petal Length",
  xlab = "Sepal Length",
  ylab = "Petal Length"
)
legend(
  "topleft",
  legend = levels(iris$Species),
  col = 1:3,
  pch = 19
)

# Q14. Outlier Detection Using IQR
cat("\n--- Q14: Ozone Outliers ---\n")
ozone <- na.omit(airquality$Ozone)
Q1 <- quantile(ozone, 0.25)
Q3 <- quantile(ozone, 0.75)
IQR_value <- IQR(ozone)
lower_bound <- Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_value
upper_bound <- Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_value
outliers <- ozone[
  ozone < lower_bound | ozone > upper_bound
]
cat("Lower bound:", lower_bound, "\n")
cat("Upper bound:", upper_bound, "\n")
cat("Outliers:", outliers, "\n")
cat("Number of outliers:", length(outliers), "\n")

# Q15. Group Comparison Using ToothGrowth
cat("\n--- Q15: ToothGrowth Analysis ---\n")
tooth_summary <- ToothGrowth %>%
  group_by(supp, dose) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_length = mean(len),
    median_length = median(len),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
print(tooth_summary)

ggplot(
  ToothGrowth,
  aes(x = factor(dose), y = len, fill = supp)
) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Tooth Growth by Supplement and Dose",
    x = "Dose",
    y = "Tooth Length",
    fill = "Supplement"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# Q16. if-else Statement
cat("\n--- Q16: Mileage Classification ---\n")
mpg_category <- ifelse(
  mtcars$mpg >= 25,
  "High mileage",
  ifelse(
    mtcars$mpg >= 15,
    "Moderate mileage",
    "Low mileage"
  )
)
result <- data.frame(
  Car_Name = rownames(mtcars),
  Mileage = mtcars$mpg,
  Category = mpg_category
)
print(result)

# Q17. for Loop
cat("\n--- Q17: Average Sepal Length ---\n")
species_names <- unique(iris$Species)
for (sp in species_names) {
  avg_length <- mean(
    iris$Sepal.Length[iris$Species == sp]
  )
  cat(
    "Species:", as.character(sp),
    "| Average Sepal Length:", avg_length, "\n"
  )
}

# Q18. while Loop
cat("\n--- Q18: Fuel Efficiency ---\n")
i <- 1
while (i <= 10) {
  car_name <- rownames(mtcars)[i]
  mileage <- mtcars$mpg[i]

  if (mileage > 20) {
    category <- "Fuel-efficient"
  } else {
    category <- "Less fuel-efficient"
  }

  cat(
    "Car:", car_name,
    "| Mileage:", mileage,
    "| Category:", category, "\n"
  )
  i <- i + 1
}

# Q19. Conditional Filtering
cat("\n--- Q19: Ozone Classification ---\n")
ozone_data <- na.omit(airquality$Ozone)
low <- 0
moderate <- 0
high <- 0

for (value in ozone_data) {
  if (value < 30) {
    low <- low + 1
  } else if (value <= 60) {
    moderate <- moderate + 1
  } else {
    high <- high + 1
  }
}

cat("Low:", low, "\n")
cat("Moderate:", moderate, "\n")
cat("High:", high, "\n")

# Q20. Integrated Programming Challenge
cat("\n--- Q20: Integrated Challenge ---\n")
final_result <- iris %>%
  filter(Petal.Length > 4) %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(
    number_of_flowers = n(),
    average_petal_length = mean(Petal.Length),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    classification = ifelse(
      average_petal_length > 4.5,
      "High Average Petal Length",
      "Low Average Petal Length"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(average_petal_length))

print(final_result)

```
